name: @house-payments/desktop
description: house-payments desktop app: Electron main, preload and renderer

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/copy-migrations.mjs && vite build
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never && node scripts/print-artifact.mjs --platform mac
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && electron-builder --win --publish never && node scripts/print-artifact.mjs --platform win
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && electron-builder --linux --publish never && node scripts/print-artifact.mjs --platform linux
